text:
mira: Quick heads-up — weekly access sentry flagged 4 identities with KMS Admin grants in prod that haven't used keys in 90+ days. Kicking off a quick triage thread, want to avoid a noisy prune if any are legit.

ops-oncall: oncall here, can run the audit query now. thanks for the ping. :eyes:

mira: ty. I already pulled the initial matches from the logs, posting commands for reproducibility:

mira: ```bash
# list IAM bindings on the prod keyrings we've been tracking
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=prod-shared --format=json | jq '.[] | {name, bindings: .bindings}'

# filter log entries for admin calls in last 6 months
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=cloud_kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName:Grant' --project=redwood-prod --limit=1000 --format=json
```

alex: thanks. can you paste the 4 identities?

mira: pasted below (anonymized):
- serviceAccount:payments-reporter@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- user:contractor-bob@example.com
- serviceAccount:legacy-batch@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- group:infra-legacy-admins@redwood.com

jordan: contractor-bob should be scoped down — he left last quarter but had a pending migration ticket. i can check the ticket and owner.

leo: legacy-batch is interesting, looks like a scheduled job that got migrated to a new SA in feb. last successful run in logs is 2025-11-02. probably safe to remove after owner confirm.

mira: plan proposal: 1) triage owners and last-use evidence, 2) annotate tickets, 3) if no owner or use in last 90 days, schedule ephemeral revoke + 48h rollback window, 4) record in audit log and notify affected teams. sound ok?

ops-oncall: +1. Please include exact revoke commands so the oncall can run during low-traffic window.

mira: revoke example (dry-run):
```bash
# remove binding
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='serviceAccount:legacy-batch@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.admin' --format=json --dry-run
```

sam: small ask — can we ensure audit logs capture the pre/post policy snapshot and link to the justification ticket? we need that for compliance evidence.

mira: yes, adding that to the runbook. we'll push a JSON snapshot to the audit-bucket and attach ticket #SEC-4721.

security-bot: automated note: last snapshot of prod-keyring-bindings taken 2026-02-10T02:14:11Z by config-bot. New snapshot will be stored at gs://redwood-audit/prod-keyring-bindings/1766661234.json

jordan: i'll own verifying contractor-bob's ticket and follow up with HR if needed.

leo: i'll check job scheduler and confirm legacy-batch owner. if it's unused i'll file the migration-deprec ticket.

mira: one open question: group infra-legacy-admins — that group has 12 members, several are active infra folks. maybe instead of blanket remove we convert the binding to a more targeted role (kmsCryptoOperator) for the few that actually need it. any objections?

alex: agree. prefer least-priv approach: narrow scope to specific SAs/users. we should run a membership audit and then do a canary—move group binding to denylist and add direct bindings for verified principals.

ops-oncall: timeline? i can do the revokes this evening after 22:00 PST if owners + ticket evidence are ready.

mira: aiming EOD for owner confirmations, else schedule for next maintenance window. i'll update SEC-4721 with steps and attach the snapshot + logs.

sam: log query to surface last KMS usage by principal (for the run):
```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp, protoPayload.methodName
FROM `redwood-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
WHERE resource.type = 'cloud_kms_key'
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 180 DAY)
  AND protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%Encrypt%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

mira: nice. we'll run that and attach results to the ticket. also adding a note for incident response: if any revoke triggers an operational regression (e.g., failed jobs), run rollback and open an incident with label kms-revoke-regression.

jordan: adding IAM owners list to SEC-4721. will ping infra leads for approvals.

mira: thanks all — will post followups here. :thumbsup:

security-bot: FYI: scheduled snapshot job will run in 10 minutes and notify this thread when complete.
